name: Weapon Specialist
prerequisite: Proficiency with at least one weapon set
description: Gain proficiency with one additional weapon set.

name: Weapon Mastery: Spades
description: You can use two-handed Spade Weapons. When using two-handed Spade weapons your base Might Strike damage is 2.  You cannot use shields while wielding a two-handed weapon.

name: Weapon Mastery: Clubs
description: You can add a ranged effect to your club weapons.

name: Weapon Mastery: Hearts
description: When you use a face card while attacking with a Heart Weapon, the enemy discards 1 card from their hand prior to taking any reaction.

name: Weapon Mastery: Diamonds
description: You double the range of Tier 0 spells.

name: Weapon Mastery: Shields
description: While wielding a shield, when you use the Parry ability, increase the blocked damage to 2.

name: Combat Medic
description: Once per Short Rest, discard a card to heal an ally 1HP. You may burn a face card to heal 2hp instead.

name: Alert
description: Add +3 to your initiative checks. You can't be surprised.

name: Quick Reflexes
description: Once per short rest, you may draw an additional card when combat begins as part of the normal scene draw.

name: Tough
description: Increase your maximum HP by 2.

name: Skilled
description: Gain proficiency in one skill.

name: Skill Training
description: Gain proficiency in one additional skill.

name: Expertise
description: Gain Expertise in one skill.

name: Keen Eye
description: Gain expertise in Perception.

name: Silver Tongue
description: Once per scene, after failing a Persuasion or Deception check, you may burn the top card of your deck to attempt the check again using the new value.

name: Iron Will
description: Gain an advantage when resisting intimidation, fear, or magical effects that attempt to influence your behavior.

name: Battlefield Medic
description: When you restore HP to an ally during a scene, they recover 1 additional HP.

name: Lucky Draw
description: Once per Short Rest, discard a card to draw one additional card.

name: Resourceful
description: Once per scene, when you would discard a card, you may instead place it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Dungeon Delver
description: Gain an advantage when detecting or avoiding mundane traps and hazards inside a dungeon. And Gain advantage on saving throws against those traps.

name: Pathfinder
description: When traveling through wilderness, your group can move at normal pace while you actively navigate and gain advantage on checks to prevent getting lost.

name: Fast Hands
description: You may draw or stow a small item as part of your Move Action.

name: Arcane Initiate
description: Learn one Tier 1 Arcane spell.

name: Divine Initiate
description: Learn one Tier 1 Divine spell.

name: Channel Adept
prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell with Channel
description: Once per scene, your first Channel card matching a spell's resonant suit provides an additional benefit determined by the spell.
